build.description: Run the full build verification (astro check + astro build).
build.prompt: Run the verify-build skill workflow: execute `npm run build` (runs `astro check` then `astro build`) from the repo root and report the result. If it fails, investigate and fix on a feature branch, then re-run until green.

add-project.description: Add a project entry to resume.json.
add-project.prompt: Add a new project to src/data/resume.json following the add-resume-entry skill exactly, then verify with npm run build.

update-gif.description: Update the daily README random-GIF list.
update-gif.prompt: Update the daily random-GIF workflow per the update-readme-gif skill: keep the GIF lists in update-readme.js, src/pages/api/random-gif.ts, and README.md in sync, then verify.
